_README: Manual owner-tenure overrides. MFL is authoritative for owner-of-record per (franchise_id, season) via worker /api/franchise-ownership-history. MFL reports END-OF-SEASON ownership, however, so this file enforces Keith's 'season-start owner gets the season' commish ruling on mid-season takeovers by reassigning the trimmed season to the previous-season MFL owner on that franchise. Keyed by franchise_id → list of owner-tenure entries. Each entry has owner_name + tenure_start_season (inclusive). tenure_end_season is optional (defaults to ongoing).
_last_updated_by: Keith (mid-season takeovers on 0005 and 0002; entries for one owner now read as one tenure with gaps)
_logic: Rebuilder builds effective_owner_by_(fid,season) starting from MFL truth, then for each override entry trims seasons < tenure_start_season (or > tenure_end_season) for the matching (fid, owner_name) and reassigns those cells to the prior-season MFL owner on that fid. Owner career stats aggregate across every (fid, season) where the effective owner matches.

0006.notes: Brian managed 0006 from mid-2024 (week 15 swap) but Josh Lima retains attribution of 2024 W/L stats per Keith 2026-05-22 (commish ruling: season-start owner gets the season). Brian's career as owner-of-record starts 2025. The 2024 cell on 0006 gets reassigned to Josh Lima (2023 MFL owner on 0006). 2023 Steve→Josh handoff was a clean preseason transfer per Keith 2026-05-23 — no override needed.

0005.notes: Eric took HammerTime over partway through 2022 from Rico Balderelli. Per the season-start-owner ruling 2022 stays with Rico, so Eric's record as owner of record starts 2023. MFL reports end-of-season ownership and credited him with Rico's 63-124 all-play year, which dragged his career mark to 55.6%; his own three seasons are 62.9%.

0002.notes: Whitman's first stint on CBP. He started 2017 and AJ Balderelli finished it, so MFL's end-of-season attribution gives AJ the season; the season-start-owner ruling gives it back to Whitman.
Whitman's second stint. AJ Balderelli owned CBP 2018-2022; Whitman took it back partway through 2022, so MFL credits him with AJ's 63-124 year and the ruling hands it back to AJ.
